import numpy as np
from sklearn.linear_model import Ridge, RidgeCV

rng = np.random.RandomState(0)
for X_shape, name in [((11, 8), "tall"), ((11, 20), "wide")]:
    X = rng.randn(*X_shape).astype(np.float32)
    y = rng.randn(X_shape[0]).astype(np.float32)
    alphas = np.logspace(-3, 3, 10)
    ridge = Ridge(alpha=alphas)
    ridge.fit(X, y)
    loo = RidgeCV(alphas=alphas, gcv_mode="svd").fit(X, y)
    probe(name, loo.alpha_)
